title: Toilet Paper Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Style | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper stand when you don’t want a wall installation? This freestanding toilet paper holder (also called a toilet paper stand or toilet tissue stand) keeps a roll ready beside the toilet—ideal for bathrooms where wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Place it anywhere for easy access; freestanding, floor stand design
- Swap rolls quickly; European-style hook makes changing the roll simple
- Stay stable on the floor; heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Coordinate classic bath accessories; Carolina Collection piece for matching Carolina with other traditional bathroom hardware
- Built from brass construction; crafted of solid brass materials

Specs & Details:
- Product type: Freestanding / floor toilet paper holder, toilet paper stand, toilet tissue stand
- Material: Solid brass (brass construction)
- Mounting: No wall mount needed (not wall-mounted; floor standing)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
